title: Phase-stabilized GeTe with optimized interfaces for high-performance thermoelectric energy conversion
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9274-9286
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04065E, Paper
Kai Xu, Yuntian Fu, Wusheng Zuo, Meng Jiang, Xin Ai, Shun Wan, Hongyi Chen, Xiaofang Lu, Lianjun Wang, Qihao Zhang, Wan Jiang
Complete stabilization of cubic GeTe by Mn–Sb co-doping combined with optimized Co diffusion barriers yields robust thermoelectric modules with a peak efficiency of 12.2%, addressing long-standing phase and interface challenges.
